stem.text: Halogenoalkanes react with $\text{NaOH(aq)}$ either by an $\text{S}_\text{N}1$ mechanism or by an $\text{S}_\text{N}2$ mechanism. The mechanism followed by the reaction depends on the structure of the halogenoalkane.
This question is about the reaction of 3-bromo-3-ethylpentane, $(\text{C}_2\text{H}_5)_3\text{CBr}$.

A.text: The mechanism is $\text{S}_\text{N}1$, due to the stabilisation of an intermediate anion by three alkyl groups.

B.text: The mechanism is $\text{S}_\text{N}1$, due to the stabilisation of an intermediate cation by three alkyl groups.

C.text: The mechanism is $\text{S}_\text{N}2$, due to the stabilisation of an intermediate anion by three alkyl groups.

D.text: The mechanism is $\text{S}_\text{N}2$, due to the stabilisation of an intermediate cation by three alkyl groups.
